summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per common share on September 10, 2026. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, or other special situation is implicated. The filing is signed by CFO Chris M. Navratil and contains no deal terms, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock. No risk-arb angle applies.
